name: code-desk
description: Set a project's starting conditions and run the work through them: interview the owner into a written quality contract, build and red-prove the one gate command that enforces it, then keep the release loop honest — the review findings a green check hides, weekly board triage through a backend adapter (GitHub Projects, Kata), recurring status comms rendered as themed PowerPoint decks, READMEs backed by live screenshots, and the project-memory taxonomy. The in-repo _meta planning system that used to ship here now lives in the mise-en-place plugin.
